en: A vintage black‑and‑white street view of ornate multi‑story buildings along a river or canal, with hills rising steeply behind them. People walk on the promenade and a horse‑drawn carriage passes in the foreground. The architecture is late‑19th/early‑20th‑century Central European. At the top left in red print is the caption "Karlsbad. Kreuzstraße." Various shop signs in German, including a bank and other businesses, are visible on the façades.
